persona_evidence.coherence-reviewer: consistency-risk: admission, exclusion, proof, and qualification terms must produce one deterministic state machine
persona_evidence.feasibility-reviewer: delivery-risk: strict cross-repository receipts and plan-sufficiency records must be mechanically representable
persona_evidence.product-lens-reviewer: product-risk: a reusable classifier must not turn a bounded cohort into a broad routing claim
persona_evidence.spec-flow-analyzer: flow-risk: preregistration, admission gates, exclusions, proof, and final decisions form a multi-state evidence lifecycle
persona_evidence.security-lens-reviewer: security-risk: live route evidence crosses trust boundaries while secrets, protected oracles, and host state must remain excluded
persona_evidence.scope-guardian-reviewer: scope-risk: planning, scoring, fixtures, documentation, and TokenZoom integration need explicit independent milestones
persona_evidence.adversarial-document-reviewer: adversarial-risk: selective cohorts, replay, correlated fixtures, forged receipts, and provider drift could falsely qualify a route
